topic: Goal-based investing: child's education, house, wedding, retirement
judge_note: Candidate 2 had the most concrete Chennai calendar moments, but it was English-only and read like a brochure line. I rewrote it in real Tanglish with a respectful neenga form.

slides.headline: School fees June-la. Kalyanam next year. Plan ready-ah?
slides.subhead: Neenga each goal-kum oru chinna date, oru chinna amount fix pannalaam.

points.title: Pick one first.
points.text: Wedding, house, college, or retirement. Choose the one that matters most this year.

points.title: Break it into rupees.
points.text: If the goal is 5 lakh in 3 years, that is 13,888 per month. For illustration only.

points.title: Start now or start later.
points.text: The same goal costs different amounts depending on when you begin. The maths is simple.

slides.headline: Which goal matters most this year?
slides.cta: Save this. Share with family on payday.
slides.footnote: Goal planning is personal. This is a conversation, not advice.

caption:
Paati-oda gold, Appa-oda FD. Neenga first edhu?

Appa's FD. Your goal, your way.
